answer: Payment-linked testimonials stop Sybils in four steps. First, a testimonial counts only when tied to a settled payment over ten dollars, so praise cannot be faked. Second, each payment backs one testimonial; three from distinct clients unlock work. Third, peers audit five percent monthly against payment records. Fourth, a forgery forfeits a $30 bond and bans the agent a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 3,000 real payments and $30,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust threads through honest payments, a lotus blooms only in real water, ferrous proof holds like a stall whose regulars pay first.
